phase3.conclusion: 3 of 3 descriptive Phase 3 hypotheses were supported by the pre-declared profiles. This is a limitation measurement, not a novelty claim.

phase4.promotion_note: PROMOTED means only that the pre-declared identifiability gates passed. The v1 grid contains the true profiles, so this is not evidence of calibration under misspecification. It is not a default decoder and not a production recommendation.
phase4.rationale: All pre-declared gates passed on held-out seeds.
